# Credential and Runner Security Checklist: Supervised Autonomous Loop

**Purpose**: Formal reviewer gate for least privilege, credential isolation, control/runner separation,
approval integrity, context privacy, and threat coverage requirements
**Created**: 2026-08-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) and [security model](../../../docs/architecture/security-model.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Trust Boundaries and Credentials

- [x] CHK001 Are supervisor browser, control plane, credentialed backend, tool gateway, runner daemon, uncredentialed job, and external-service trust zones distinguished with authenticated boundaries? [Completeness, Security Model §Trust zones]
- [x] CHK002 Is the prohibition on arbitrary repository code in the control plane stated without an evaluation-mode exception? [Clarity, Constitution §XI; Plan §Architecture]
- [x] CHK003 Are provider credentials, harness credential homes, opaque references, compiled context, and job environments defined so credential material cannot enter the runner job? [Completeness, Constitution §XI/XV; Security Model §Core controls]
- [x] CHK004 Is consumer-cookie/session scraping, proxying, emulation, export, or repurposing explicitly prohibited across both API and harness modes? [Coverage, Constitution §XV; Backend Research §Status vocabulary]
- [x] CHK005 Is loopback-only evaluation binding required to fail closed for non-loopback exposure until a future authentication profile is configured? [Clarity, Research §R-009; HTTP Contract §server]

## Capability, Approval, and Isolation Quality

- [x] CHK006 Are tool capabilities scoped by operation, resource, arguments, expiry, budget, parent grant, and revocation state before invocation? [Completeness, Data Model §ToolCapability]
- [x] CHK007 Is the first runner's lack of shell, network, provider auth, and multi-job support explicit so fixture execution cannot be mistaken for production OCI isolation? [Clarity, Research §R-007; Runner Contract §register]
- [x] CHK008 Are runner lease expiry and fencing requirements sufficient to reject a stale runtime before it can mutate fixture ground truth? [Measurability, Spec §FR-026; Runner Contract §fixtureCommand/result]
- [x] CHK009 Is approval bound to an immutable action digest, requester, scope, risk, expiry, and one supervisor decision, with changed/replayed payload behavior defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016/FR-017]
- [x] CHK010 Are stop/cancel semantics defined for capability revocation, safe checkpointing, uncertain-effect reconciliation, and races with completion? [Coverage, Spec §US2 Scenario 4; Edge Cases]

## Threat and Privacy Coverage

- [x] CHK011 Are prompt injection, malicious dependencies, secret access, privilege escalation, cross-project contamination, unsafe model output, duplicate effects, destructive Git, egress, approval spoofing, and audit tampering all represented by a requirement or deliberate later gate? [Coverage, Security Model §Threat model]
- [x] CHK012 Does the context requirement define inclusion reasons, provenance, hashes, classification, destination, and explicit exclusion of credentials, raw chat, and private reasoning? [Completeness, Spec §FR-041; Context Architecture §Context manifest]
- [x] CHK013 Are artifact path traversal, size, hash tampering, missing bytes, and revision mismatch requirements explicit? [Coverage, Plan §Data, Contracts, and Security Design; Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK014 Are logs, events, errors, evidence bundles, and UI projections required to exclude secrets, host-sensitive paths, and private chain-of-thought while retaining useful audit rationale? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013/FR-036; Quickstart §Evidence bundle]
- [x] CHK015 Are default-deny network and no-real-provider constraints measurable in automated negative tests rather than only stated as architecture? [Measurability, Spec §FR-009/FR-037; Quickstart §Automated acceptance]
- [x] CHK016 Are future rootless OCI claims gated on cgroups, subordinate IDs, network, storage, filesystem, and resource-control probes rather than assumed from Podman presence? [Completeness, Research §R-007; PVE Deployment §Reference workload]

## Notes

- Independent security requirements review accepted all 16/16 items on 2026-08-31.
- A checked item does not certify the runner or any provider connection as production-safe.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist state as a gate and must not modify markers.
